description: Read a workspace's sandbox quotas and retention policy: max snapshots/templates/volumes/total bytes, max concurrent and sticky sessions, max preview URLs, and the pause/snapshot retention periods. These are workspace limits — there are no per-session defaults (idle timeout and max duration are set per sandbox at creation).

workspace_id.description: Workspace to read. Omit to use the API key's first workspace.

name: tenki_get_workspace_settings
